reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that reads Headroom savings data and presents live usage and cost-savings metrics in a settings dashboard and composer status line.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中读取 Headroom 节省数据，并通过设置仪表盘和输入区状态行展示实时令牌与成本节省统计。
summaries.en: Reads Headroom savings data in DeepSeek Harness and displays live token and cost-savings statistics in a settings dashboard and composer status line.

capabilities: Reads a configured local Headroom savings JSON file
Displays live token and cost-savings statistics in the DSH web UI
Polls a local plugin API every five seconds
Performs a one-time subprocess call to retrieve environment variable values
